annotation.justification: The target clause provides clear guidance on client behavior regarding the SETTINGS frame and sending requests. It uses SHOULD to indicate recommended behavior without implying multiple materially different interpretations. The clause specifies that clients should not wait indefinitely and should process received datagrams to increase the likelihood of processing SETTINGS before the first request. This does not introduce ambiguity in implementation behavior.
